findings.quote: Modules under `src/adrcheck/domain/` import only the standard library and each other.
findings.reason: Line relocates the Mapping import within the standard library (typing → collections.abc), preserving the domain's no‑forbidden‑import rule.

findings.line_text: offenders = [(p.name, mod) for p in DOMAIN.glob("*.py") for mod in imports_of(p) if mod.startswith(FORBIDDEN)]
findings.quote: The boundary is enforced by `tests/test_boundaries.py`, which fails on the first offending import.
findings.reason: Line reformats the offenders list comprehension; the logic of collecting offending imports and failing on them is unchanged.

findings.quote: Every CONFLICT carries a changed line and a verbatim quote from the ADR.
findings.reason: Line reformats the call to verify(); the verification of the changed line and ADR quote is unchanged.

findings.quote: `verify()` in `src/adrcheck/domain/verify.py` checks both before the verdict stands: the line must be in the change
findings.reason: Line fixes a code‑block marker and a typo in the design doc that describes the verify rule; the verify logic itself is untouched.

findings.quote: Only CONFLICT can make `adrcheck check` exit 2 under `--fail-on conflict`.
findings.reason: Line renames a variable and reformats argument definitions; the exit‑code logic for —fail‑on conflict is unchanged.

findings.quote: The report must show UNCLEAR counts so a run that abstained on everything is visible as such.
findings.reason: Line reformats the decision_signals and stale lists in the render output; the count aggregation for UNCLEAR findings is unchanged.

findings.quote: An ADR is compiled into obligations by an `ObligationCompiler` once.
findings.reason: Line reformats the write_text call in CachedCompiler; the one‑time compilation and caching logic is unchanged.

findings.line_text: obl = "\n".join(f'- {o.id} [{o.kind}, {o.checkability.value}] {o.text}\n  quote: "{o.quote}"' for o in obligations)

findings.reason: Line reformats the prompt string construction in ClaudeJudge; the judge still receives only compiled obligations.
